acceptanceCriteria: release and attempt heartbeat accept a caller-chosen bounded --lock-wait SECONDS (bounded maximum, documented) and wait on the prepare lock instead of returning LOCK_TIMEOUT after the default wait.
Re-submitting an evidence HANDOFF release after LOCK_TIMEOUT with the same request ID is safe: it either commits once or replays the committed receipt, never a duplicate or a conflict.
No path silently converts a plain release into a HANDOFF; any fallback that keeps HANDOFF accounting requires the caller's explicit intent and the original evidence.
Spec requirements are added and maintained tests cover lock contention with --lock-wait, same-request-ID replay after a timeout, and the absence of a retry charge on the replayed HANDOFF.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

GitHub beamfall/corvint#637 (main-2fff511, 6-10 concurrent workers, journal head about 12,500). Evidence-form HANDOFF releases return the retryable LOCK_TIMEOUT on .git/taskman.prepare.lock (35 status files, 66 lines). A retry with a new request ID usually succeeds, but when it also times out, workers fall back to a plain release (FL-002 gen 2646, receipt 12144). That charges a retry and can quarantine the pool member, forcing a lane reset of 3-5 minutes. Related: #494, #545, V1-0645.

completion.reason: Landed in beamfall/corvint PR #638, merge 3dc863bd75e163d723a5b116060caef2317d2d8a (fixes GitHub issue #637). release and attempt heartbeat accept --lock-wait 1..300 seconds and wait on the prepare lock (CAL-V0-111); orphan cleanup in lease recovery uses the caller wait. Same-request HANDOFF release after LOCK_TIMEOUT commits once or replays the committed receipt with no retry charge (CAL-V0-112). No plain release is converted to HANDOFF (CAL-V0-113). Maintained tests TestCALV0111/112/113 cover lock contention with --lock-wait, same-request replay after a timeout and no retry charge; they passed on authority, store and cli, and all hosted CI checks passed on the merge head. Codex review finding (orphan cleanup wait) was fixed before merge. Limit: live fleet qualification NOT_RUN.

title: corvint-tasks release --reason HANDOFF returns LOCK_TIMEOUT on the prepare lock; the plain-release fallback charges a retry and quarantines the lane (issue 637)
